Name: Waterfall Tilesheets
Author: Draylon
Description:
This Mod is to make more Freely Usable the Waterfall Assets that were originally Made by Maleha 5 years ago.

So you don't have to rely on another dependancy like DaisyNiko's Tilesheets (Which Has DP-Enabled),
or Try To Find it on the Forums yourself. (Which Ironically I realize I can just also Link [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/waterfall-tilesheet-w-animation.132102/page-2]here.[/url])

This Mod is going to be DP-Free, and will remain as such as they are free use Assets created by Maleha for the community.

This Mod will Load the Assets using CP under their default names.
You can choose to list this as a dependancy or just grab the files and bundle them in your own mod instead (no Dependancy Required) as they are free use.

Props to Maleha For Making one of the Most Beloved assets of modders!

Quote From Maleha, "Thank you all for your help and constructive criticism, it came out like this with your input and as such I don't think I should claim credit really. Anyone can use it, so long as you keep it free and accessible to people." (5 years ago)
